meta.note: Educational tracks serving ENSNN students. Official current degree labels should be confirmed with the school; paths are not claimed to be the authorized ENSNN syllabus.

paths.name: Engineering foundations
paths.description: Circuits, devices, mathematics, signals and scientific computing.
paths.goal: A notebook with circuit calculations, MOS physics and reproducible plots.

steps.name: Circuits and SPICE
steps.concept: DC/AC analysis, basic transistors and feedback.
steps.deliverable: Verify a transistor bias point and an RC transient.

steps.name: Signals and mathematics
steps.concept: Fourier/Laplace transforms, sampling and uncertainty.
steps.deliverable: Simulate filtering a noisy signal and report units and error.

steps.name: Semiconductor physics
steps.concept: Bands, junctions, transport and MOS electrostatics.
steps.deliverable: Calculate and explain a diode and MOS device.

steps.name: Reproducible Python
steps.concept: Data arrays, scientific fitting, scientific plotting and version control.
steps.deliverable: Publish a notebook regenerating every figure.

paths.name: Sensors & Smart Systems
paths.description: An end-to-end sensing system: physical sensor, readout, calibration, firmware, communication and intelligence.
paths.goal: A tested sensing node with uncertainty and energy measurements.

steps.name: Specify and select
steps.concept: Sensor principle, measurand, operating range and performance metrics.
steps.deliverable: Specification and comparison matrix for three candidate sensors.

steps.name: Model transduction
steps.concept: Chemical, capacitive, piezoelectric, thermal and optical conversion.
steps.deliverable: Transfer function and simulation with stated assumptions.

steps.name: Signal conditioning
steps.concept: Sensor amplifiers, ADCs, noise and calibration.
steps.deliverable: SPICE circuit and noise/ADC budget.

steps.name: Embedded acquisition
steps.concept: ADC, SPI, I2C, timestamps and MCU firmware.
steps.deliverable: Sensor acquisition firmware handling missed measurements.

steps.name: Networks & protocols
steps.concept: BLE, MQTT, RPL and power-aware wireless networks.
steps.deliverable: MQTT telemetry or simulated multi-hop sensor mesh.

steps.name: Embedded intelligence
steps.concept: Baseline detection, TinyML and hardware limitations.
steps.deliverable: Compare threshold, statistics and tiny ML error/latency.

steps.name: Validation
steps.concept: Repeatability, drift, uncertainty, battery use and robustness.
steps.deliverable: Calibration plots, uncertainty budget and test report.

paths.name: Micro/nanosensor design
paths.description: Select a sensing principle, develop a fabrication concept and validate a physical model.
paths.goal: Sensor device proposal with layouts, numerical results and test plan.

steps.name: Sensor architecture
steps.concept: Choose transduction physics and selectivity strategy.
steps.deliverable: Design brief with measurable output and interfering variables.

steps.name: Sensing materials
steps.concept: Crystal properties, thin film layers and functionalization.
steps.deliverable: Material selection matrix with justified citations.

steps.name: Fabrication flow
steps.concept: Lithography, deposition, etch, contacts, packaging.
steps.deliverable: Mask list, cross-sections and process flow.

steps.name: Simulation
steps.concept: Choose electrical TCAD or MEMS multiphysics correctly.
steps.deliverable: Mesh-convergence and parameter-sweep plots.

steps.name: Characterization
steps.concept: Sensor readout, controls and repeatability.
steps.deliverable: Calibrated measured-or-simulated curves marked honestly.

paths.name: Silvaco and TCAD
paths.description: Device/process simulation from physical equations to validated model decks.
paths.goal: MOSFET or photodiode model with reproducible curves and convergence checks.

steps.name: Transport equations
steps.concept: Poisson, drift-diffusion, recombination and doping.
steps.deliverable: Analytic baseline device response.

steps.name: Learn the tool flow
steps.concept: Meshing, physical models, boundary conditions and sweeps.
steps.deliverable: Document a device geometry and the installed simulator version.

steps.name: Device simulation
steps.concept: Bias and optical generation in a semiconductor.
steps.deliverable: Run and analyze ID–VG/ID–VD or photocurrent curves.

steps.name: Process simulation
steps.concept: Implantation, diffusion, deposition, oxidation and etching.
steps.deliverable: Conceptual ATHENA/Victory process sequence.

steps.name: Verify the results
steps.concept: Mesh density, solver errors, convergence, model validity.
steps.deliverable: Mesh independence report with clearly noted assumptions.

paths.name: Microfabrication and cleanroom
paths.description: Manufacturing concepts with practical process planning and supervised lab requirements.
paths.goal: Conceptual process traveler and inspection plan, not an unperformed fabrication claim.

steps.name: Cleanroom practice
steps.concept: Contamination, vacuum and institutional safety requirements.
steps.deliverable: Safety/process dependency checklist.

steps.name: Thin film techniques
steps.concept: PVD, sputtering, CVD, oxidation, ALD.
steps.deliverable: Pick film growth routes for active layer and contacts.

steps.name: Pattern & etch
steps.concept: Photolithography, resists, masks, etch and metrology.
steps.deliverable: Mask-level drawings and intermediate device cross sections.

steps.name: Testing & reproducibility
steps.concept: Layer thickness, alignment, defects and process yield.
steps.deliverable: Inspection checklist and tolerances.

paths.name: MEMS modeling and actuation
paths.description: Micromechanics, transduction, coupled-field models and realistic device packaging.
paths.goal: Simulated microcantilever, membrane or electrothermal actuator with design sweeps.

steps.name: Microscale mechanics
steps.concept: Beam and membrane stiffness, resonance and damping.
steps.deliverable: Hand estimates for a cantilever or membrane.

steps.name: Coupled physics
steps.concept: Electrostatic, mechanical, piezoelectric and thermal coupling.
steps.deliverable: Compare simple model against coupled FEM.

steps.name: Mesh & calibration
steps.concept: Geometry, constraints, boundary conditions and convergence.
steps.deliverable: Show at least two meshes and one parameter sensitivity.

steps.name: Readout & validation
steps.concept: Capacitance/strain/temperature outputs and electronics.
steps.deliverable: Simulated response converted into an electronic measurement.

paths.name: Nanomaterials and characterization
paths.description: Synthesis method selection, structure, surface measurement and reproducibility.
paths.goal: Characterization plan with spectral/micrograph analysis and uncertainty.

steps.name: Materials physics
steps.concept: Bonds, phases, defects and functional nanostructures.
steps.deliverable: Select an oxide or semiconductor material for a sensing application.

steps.name: Thin film preparation
steps.concept: Growth, sputtering, CVD and processing tradeoffs.
steps.deliverable: Flowchart with process conditions to research, not unsafe procedural recipes.

steps.name: XRD/XPS
steps.concept: Diffraction phases and surface chemistry.
steps.deliverable: Index peaks or tabulate literature binding energies.

steps.name: SEM/AFM
steps.concept: Surface morphology and dimensional measurements.
steps.deliverable: Annotated image analysis with scale and roughness.

steps.name: Measure effects
steps.concept: Electrode I–V, temperature or gas response, replicate data.
steps.deliverable: Curves with raw data, controls and uncertainty.

paths.name: Biosensors and lab-on-chip
paths.description: Biorecognition, microfluidic transport, biochemical transduction and controls.
paths.goal: Well-justified LoC design with microfluidic flow and measurement strategy.

steps.name: Biorecognition
steps.concept: Enzymes, antibodies, nonspecific binding and chemical interferences.
steps.deliverable: Target/probe selection and specificity checklist.

steps.name: Signal conversion
steps.concept: Electrochemical and optical readout.
steps.deliverable: Plan an assay with negative controls and measurable output.

steps.name: Microfluidics
steps.concept: Flow, diffusion and transport in small channels.
steps.deliverable: Estimate diffusion length and residence time.

steps.name: Device integration
steps.concept: Packaging, electrode placement and electronics.
steps.deliverable: Microsystem diagram from inlet to digital output.

paths.name: Sensor networks, IoT and TinyML
paths.description: Sensing, reliable data transmission, low-power networks and edge processing.
paths.goal: Live or simulated multi-node system with telemetry, anomaly detection and power budget.

steps.name: Firmware
steps.concept: MCU peripherals, interrupts, sensor APIs.
steps.deliverable: Working sensor polling and fault handling.

steps.name: Network protocols
steps.concept: BLE, MQTT, CoAP, RPL mesh and radio interference.
steps.deliverable: Run a multi-node Cooja example.

steps.name: Dashboards
steps.concept: Timestamps, telemetry streams and alerts.
steps.deliverable: Publish MQTT packets and plot real/simulated data.

steps.name: On-device inference
steps.concept: Quantization, model profiling and TinyML.
steps.deliverable: Deploy inference and compare with simple threshold baseline.

steps.name: Reliability
steps.concept: Packet loss, drift, battery energy and robust alerts.
steps.deliverable: Power and packet-loss report with failure handling.

paths.name: Analog and mixed-signal IC
paths.description: Transistor sizing, noise, circuits, layout and sensor readout ASICs.
paths.goal: Verified analog front-end with bias, gain, noise, corner and layout results.

steps.name: MOS circuits
steps.concept: Small-signal models, transconductance and bias.
steps.deliverable: Derive amplifier gain and bias.

steps.name: Design building blocks
steps.concept: Current mirrors, differential pairs, compensation.
steps.deliverable: Design a 2-stage amplifier.

steps.name: SPICE practice
steps.concept: AC/transient/noise analysis and automated sweeps.
steps.deliverable: Document simulations and assumptions.

steps.name: Physical implementation
steps.concept: Open PDK layouts and extracted parasitics.
steps.deliverable: Layout checks and schematic extraction comparison.

steps.name: Application
steps.concept: Build instrumentation chain for real sensing.
steps.deliverable: Noise and digitization analysis.

paths.name: Digital ASIC RTL to GDS
paths.description: Digital logic, verification, synthesis and physical design with open tooling.
paths.goal: RTL tested in simulation and implemented in a PDK-aware backend flow.

steps.name: Logic design
steps.concept: FSM, timing, memory and architecture.
steps.deliverable: Make a well-specified ALU or register bank.

steps.name: Code RTL
steps.concept: Synthesizable Verilog, clocks and resets.
steps.deliverable: Solve HDL exercises and test corners.

steps.name: Verification
steps.concept: Waveforms, assertions and constrained stimuli.
steps.deliverable: Automated regression with checks.

steps.name: Synthesis
steps.concept: Standard cells, logic depth, area and timing.
steps.deliverable: Synthesize and compare timing/area.

steps.name: Place and route
steps.concept: Floorplan, placement, clock tree, routing and DRC.
steps.deliverable: Create GDS and inspect backend checks.

steps.name: Chip project
steps.concept: Reproducible packaging and optional shuttle design.
steps.deliverable: Prepare a public checked RTL-to-GDS repo.

paths.name: FPGA and embedded systems
paths.description: Practical hardware design for architecture and inference acceleration.
paths.goal: Verified FPGA prototype with measured LUTs, clocks, latency and interfaces.

steps.name: Design basics
steps.concept: Logic, pipelining, control and datapaths.
steps.deliverable: Build a pipelined arithmetic block.

steps.name: RTL implementation
steps.concept: Hardware description and unit testbenches.
steps.deliverable: Build UART or SPI and regression tests.

steps.name: Vendor tool flow
steps.concept: Timing constraints, simulation, synthesis and bitstream.
steps.deliverable: Implement a design and inspect timing.

steps.name: FPGA SoCs
steps.concept: RISC-V, address mapping and acceleration.
steps.deliverable: Add a sensor-processing core and benchmark.

steps.name: Measurements
steps.concept: Evaluate real cost and reliability.
steps.deliverable: Document resource use, clock and latency.

paths.name: Integrated photonics and optical sensing
paths.description: Propagation, PIC modeling, physical layout and resonator-based sensing.
paths.goal: Microring sensor geometry, spectrum and temperature drift analysis.

steps.name: Optical basics
steps.concept: Maxwell equations, waveguides and resonances.
steps.deliverable: Derive waveguide mode and basic resonance.

steps.name: FDTD methods
steps.concept: Sources, boundaries, meshing and spectra.
steps.deliverable: Simulate a ring and extract Q and FSR.

steps.name: Photonic layout
steps.concept: Waveguide bends, coupling, design rules.
steps.deliverable: Build parametric GDS cell.

steps.name: System level
steps.concept: S parameters, temperature compensation and robustness.
steps.deliverable: Quantify temperature shift and propose correction.

steps.name: Research results
steps.concept: Compare results to a reference publication.
steps.deliverable: Reproducible graphs and models.

paths.name: Research and reporting
paths.description: Reading papers, benchmarking, scientific computing, uncertainty and technical communication.
paths.goal: A short reproducible research report with code, figures and citations.

steps.name: Search literature
steps.concept: Citation chains and research question scope.
steps.deliverable: Create a related work matrix.

steps.name: Model and benchmark
steps.concept: Baselines, scripts and sensitivity analysis.
steps.deliverable: Plot a verified baseline with units.

steps.name: Uncertainty
steps.concept: Statistical, numerical and physical limitations.
steps.deliverable: Sensitivity/uncertainty budget.

steps.name: Write evidence
steps.concept: Paper structure, methods and diagrams.
steps.deliverable: Draft 5–8 page research note with linked code.
